result.headline: Throttle commanded to 0 at t=101.254 s, then pitch moved opposite its setpoint and altitude fell to 13.084 m.
result.explanation: The controller's throttle output dropped to 0 at 101.254 s with no logged mode or failsafe event. The propulsion channel went to minimum, and altitude loss and inverted pitch followed. What triggered the cut is not in this data.

evidence.quote: CHANGE propulsion.throttle at t=101.254 s: 59.5 -> 0 % (step -59.5, 59.5x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Throttle fell to 0 and stayed at 0 to the end of the recording. The earlier drops at 35.33 s and 71.199 s only went to 32 and 35.5 %.

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[2]] at t=101.297 s: 1576 -> 1100 us (step -476, 59.5x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: The propulsion actuator channel went to its minimum right after the throttle command dropped. Nothing was logged in between.

evidence.quote: CHANGE vehicle.altitude[relative] at t=105.474 s: 45.509 -> 27.129 m (step -18.38, 83.9x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Altitude fell from 50.462 m at 102.562 s to 13.084 m at 109.156 s. This is an effect of the thrust loss.
Pitch tracking error in the last stretch was far above every earlier stretch. Pitch followed the setpoint with the opposite sign (correlation -0.988 at 0.971 s lag).

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.684 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: A sensor-health error and a low-voltage warning were logged at start-up. Nothing was logged around the throttle cut.

checked.check: Order of events in the last stretch (sequence from 95 s)
checked.result: ch[3] to ch[5] moved first at 96.375 s, the roll setpoint at 98.32 s. Throttle then dropped to 0 at 101.254 s, ch[2] followed at 101.725 s, the pitch setpoint at 102.553 s, and pitch attitude, altitude and velocity after that. No events were logged.
checked.about: Controller-commanded throttle cut as the earliest fault sign

checked.check: Window 98-109.2 s: throttle, ch[2], pitch and altitude
checked.result: Throttle was 0 from 101.254 s. ch[2] was 1100 from 101.725 s. The pitch setpoint went to about -24.9 deg while pitch attitude rose to 25.237 deg. Altitude fell to 13.084 m.
checked.about: Propulsion loss and inverted pitch after the cut

checked.result: Correlation was -0.824 at zero lag and -0.988 at 0.971 s lag. Typical error was 30.571 deg and the worst was 50.227 deg at 105.28 s.
checked.about: Pitch response inverted: pitch control path or airframe effect

checked.check: Roll setpoint against attitude over the whole recording
checked.result: Correlation at 0.971 s lag was 0.961 and typical error 4.783 deg. Roll also tracked after the cut: setpoint -10.84 deg gave attitude -7.368 deg about one lag later.
checked.about: Whole-aircraft attitude estimate or IMU fault

checked.result: No signal left its baseline in order. The low-voltage and sensor-health messages appear at 0.684 s and no similar event appears near the throttle cut. The roll error at t=0 is a start-up transient.
checked.about: Battery and sensor-health warnings as the trigger

outcomes.then: Trace what raised the failsafe and check its thresholds
